Subject: A question about your team calendar

Hello,

I hope you are doing well. I am reaching out because I offer help organizing a shared project calendar, and I thought this might be relevant to the work you do with your team.

A shared calendar can give people a common place to look when they are coordinating their work. Organizing that information can also create an opportunity to talk about what the team needs from the calendar and how it fits into the way people work together.

I would be interested in learning more about your current approach and whether organizing a shared project calendar is something you have been considering. If it is useful, we could have a conversation about the team's needs and what a helpful calendar might look like.

Would you be open to a conversation? I am happy to start with a brief exchange about what your team is looking for and whether my help might be a fit.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.
